items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: The only one that I remember was Henny Brunus... And Bill Gallaty, well, he played vowel. He played a fair vowel trombone, see?

ctx.x: Uh, you, uh, when you started on trombone though, were there any good trombone players here then?

No, not that I remembered of. The only one that I remember was Henny Brunus. He played fair trombone. He played fair trombone. And Bill Gallaty, well, he played vowel. He played a fair vowel trombone, see? And that's Joe Ellibusch, well, he was a horrible trombone player, but he... Like I tell you, he was the leader of the band, so he was the boss man, he was the trombone player.
Yeah. What about Dave Perkins? Did you ever hear him?
